label: D1 after an unrewarded rare a2->S1 transition (stay-on-a2 signal), mid-episode
explanation: Fires almost only at D1 (99.9% of mass), only with reward input 0, and ~81% of its mass is on D1s right after a trial where the agent chose a2, got the rare transition to S1, and was not rewarded: the rare-unrewarded case where a model-based agent should stay on a2 (the upcoming choice is a2 on essentially all its activations; policy logit strongly favours a2). Most of the remaining ~19% is at the first D1 of the window, where the previous trial is outside the window (likely the same situation). Precision is limited by two things the predicate handles crudely: (1) it is strongly confined to the middle of the episode (ep_trial ~25-80; zero activations before trial 20 or after 85), and (2) it mostly does not fire again when the trial before also ended unrewarded. Using only observed variables. Adding the model policy logit band (choice < -4.44) raises dev F1 to 0.79; this was not recorded. Does not fire at GO or D2, after rewarded trials, after a1 choices, or after common unrewarded trials. Magnitude not analysed.
